title: Diagonal Traverse
summary: Read a grid along its anti-diagonals, zig-zagging up-right then down-left, starting at the top-left cell.

tests.explain: The path is 1, then 2 4 going down-left, then 7 5 3 going up-right, then 6 8, then 9.
A 2 x 3 grid has four diagonals: 1 | 2 4 | 5 3 | 6.
A 3 x 2 grid also has four diagonals: 1 | 2 3 | 5 4 | 6.

hints: All cells on the same anti-diagonal share the same value of row + column. Walk the diagonals in order of that sum.
The direction alternates: even sums run up-right (row decreasing), odd sums run down-left (row increasing).
Either collect each diagonal and reverse every other one, or simulate: step by (-1, +1) or (+1, -1) and, when you leave the grid, move to the next diagonal's start and flip the direction.

complexity.space: O(1) beyond the output (O(min(rows, columns)) if you collect each diagonal)
